entities.summary: Rakim Sanders is an American former professional basketball player. He played college basketball with the Boston College Eagles for three seasons, and with the Fairfield Stags, for one season. At a height of 1.96 m tall, he played at both the shooting guard and small forward positions, with small forward being his main position.
